natives.name: SoldierExecute
natives.note: Execute current soldier in level, Param: ptr = (addr+0x2EC) and soldier address.

natives.name: AIAction_Patrol
natives.signature: void AIAction_Patrol(int path_id, int start_node, int end_node);
natives.note: Assigns patrol route path and node loop boundaries for AI guard entity.

natives.name: AIAction_Combat
natives.note: Engages specified target entity in combat state.

natives.name: AIAction_Dead
natives.note: Triggers death state, animation, and drop weapon behavior.

natives.name: AIAction_Activate
natives.signature: void AIAction_Activate(int object_id, int action_id, float duration);
natives.note: Triggers interactable object activation (alarm button, door switch).

natives.name: AIAction_WalkToNode
natives.note: Orders guard AI to walk to a designated path node.

natives.name: AIAction_RunToNode
natives.note: Orders guard AI to run to a designated path node.

natives.name: AIAction_FireAtNode
natives.signature: void AIAction_FireAtNode(int node_id, int weapon_id, int burst_count, float delay, int aim_mode);
natives.note: Fires weapon at a specific world node location.

natives.name: AIAction_FireAtTask
natives.signature: void AIAction_FireAtTask(int task_id, int weapon_id, int burst_count, float delay, int aim_mode);
natives.note: Fires weapon at target task object (player or camera).

natives.name: AIAction_PlayAnimation
natives.note: Plays skeletal animation sequence on AI guard model.

natives.name: AIAction_PlaySound
natives.signature: void AIAction_PlaySound(int sound_id, float volume, float pitch);
natives.note: Triggers voice/sound playback on AI guard entity.

natives.name: AIAction_MoveToEvent
natives.note: Orders AI to move toward detected sound or vision event location.

natives.name: AIAction_LookAtEvent
natives.note: Rotates AI head/eyes to look at event origin.

natives.name: AIAction_Stunned
natives.note: Puts AI into stunned reaction state (e.g. Flashbang).

natives.name: AIAction_KickGrenade
natives.note: Triggers grenade kick reaction sequence.

natives.name: AIAction_RunPanicking
natives.note: Orders unarmed civilian/guard to run panicking away.

natives.name: AIAction_Idle
natives.note: Puts AI guard in passive idle stance for specified time.

natives.name: AIAction_SetCombat
natives.note: Sets aggressive/defensive combat mode parameters.

natives.name: AIFunction_DefaultHandler
natives.note: Default fallback script event handler.

natives.name: AIFunction_RemoveAlarmActions
natives.note: Clears pending alarm switch activation goals.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetViewLength
natives.note: Sets primary acute vision cone sight distance.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmViewLength
natives.note: Sets sight distance while alarm is active.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetViewAlpha
natives.note: Sets primary vision cone half-angle alpha.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetViewGamma
natives.note: Sets primary vision cone detection rate gamma.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryViewLength
natives.note: Sets secondary peripheral vision cone distance.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryAlarmViewLength
natives.note: Sets secondary peripheral vision cone distance under alarm.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryViewAlpha
natives.note: Sets secondary vision cone angle.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetSecondaryViewGamma
natives.note: Sets secondary vision cone detection rate.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetEventPriority
natives.note: Sets event queue evaluation priority for guard script.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetInvulnerability
natives.note: Sets invulnerability flag (1 = godmode / mission object).

natives.name: AIFunction_SetInstantDeath
natives.note: Forces immediate death on single bullet hit.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetDeathAnimation
natives.note: Assigns specific death animation index.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmTriggerID
natives.note: Links guard AI to alarm button task ID.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmControlID
natives.note: Links guard AI to alarm control panel task ID.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetAlarmAccess
natives.note: Sets guard permission to trigger alarms.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetGunnerID
natives.note: Links AI guard to stationary gun/turret task ID.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetScriptIntegerValue
natives.note: Sets internal integer script state variable.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetScriptRealValue
natives.note: Sets internal float script state variable.

natives.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmTriggerID
natives.note: Returns linked alarm trigger task ID.

natives.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmControlID
natives.note: Returns linked alarm control panel task ID.

natives.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmAccess
natives.note: Returns guard alarm access permissions.

natives.name: AIFunction_GetGunnerID
natives.note: Returns linked stationary gun task ID.

natives.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmControlStatus
natives.note: Queries if global level alarm is active (0 or 1).

natives.name: AIFunction_GetGunnerStatus
natives.note: Queries if linked gunner turret is occupied.

natives.name: AIFunction_GetScriptIntegerValue
natives.note: Reads integer script state variable.

natives.name: AIFunction_GetCurrentEventType
natives.note: Returns active detected event type (Gunshot, Vision, Impact).

natives.name: AIFunction_IsEventBehind
natives.note: Returns 1 if detected sound/event originates behind guard.

natives.name: AIFunction_GetScriptRealValue
natives.note: Reads float script state variable.

natives.name: AIFunction_GetRandomValue
natives.note: Generates random float between 0.0 and max using PRNG 0x4B4740.

natives.name: AIFunction_GetEventDistance
natives.note: Returns distance to detected event origin.

natives.name: AIFunction_GetAlarmTriggerDistance
natives.note: Returns distance between guard and alarm switch.

natives.name: AIFunction_SetAnimationInterval
natives.note: Sets min/max interval between ambient idle animations.

natives.name: AIFunction_AddAnimationEntry
natives.note: Adds weighted animation entry to idle animation pool.

natives.name: AIFunction_GetAnimationToPlay
natives.note: Selects animation index from weighted idle pool.

natives.name: AIFunction_SendResponse
natives.note: Sends AI response signal to event pump.
